note: Attacker-controlled bytes are handed to libvips as an image buffer.
The input buffer is wrapped without copying, so downstream loaders read the original attacker bytes.
The EXIF blob attached to the image is parsed before smartcrop runs.
libvips disables specification-fixing and forwards the raw EXIF bytes into libexif.

code: if( !memcmp( d, ExifHeader, 6 ) ) ... exif_data_load_data_content( data, EXIF_IFD_0, d + 6, ds - 6, offset, 0 );
note: The parser accepts the EXIF header and begins walking IFD0 entries from attacker-controlled offsets.

code: o = exif_get_long( d + offset + 12 * i + 8, data->priv->order );
note: A tag entry supplies a sub-IFD or thumbnail offset that is derived directly from the input.

code: exif_data_load_data_content( data, EXIF_IFD_EXIF, d, ds, o, recursion_cost + level_cost(n) );
note: The offset is recursively followed into a nested EXIF IFD, extending parsing into attacker-chosen structure.
Entry payload bytes are copied from the attacker buffer using the computed offset and size.
The parsed EXIF thumbnail is attached back to the image and later consumed by smartcrop-related processing.
